en: Colored postcard showing the rear view of a large convent complex with red-tiled roofs featuring distinctive eye‑shaped dormer windows, white and pastel building facades, a small tower with a spire, and lush gardens in the foreground. On the image side, printed titles in German and Hungarian read "Hermannstadt / Nagyszeben" and "Ursulinenkloster (Rückansicht) / Orsolya-zárda (Hátsó látképe)". The reverse side has handwritten text in Hungarian, a divided back with address lines, Romanian postage stamps, and a collector's stamp.
